description: This file defines a Razor ViewComponent named 'Basket' for an ASP.NET Core web application. It manages the display of the shopping basket in the UI, including counting total items either for signed-in users or anonymous ones by retrieving cookies.

classes.name: Basket
classes.description: A ViewComponent responsible for rendering the shopping basket, retrieving item count based on user login status or cookies.

methods.name: InvokeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously constructs the basket view model with total item count and returns the view result.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Determines the total number of items in the basket for the current user, either signed-in or anonymous.

methods.name: GetAnnonymousIdFromCookie
methods.description: Retrieves an anonymous user identifier from cookies if available and valid.
